cases.title: Discard password on Never For This Site
cases.description: Verify that the browser discards the password when 'Never For This Site' is selected in the save password dialog box.

cases.title: Retain password on dialog dismissal
cases.description: Verify that the password is not discarded when the save password dialog box is cancelled or dismissed without selecting 'Never For This Site'.

cases.title: Present multiple saved credentials
cases.description: Verify that when multiple usernames and passwords for a website are saved, those same choices are later available to be presented when filling forms.

cases.title: Presentation behavior with zero or single credential
cases.description: Verify the credential presentation behavior when there is zero or only a single username and password saved for a website.

cases.title: Detect New Password Upon Change
cases.description: Verify that when a saved username and password for a website is subsequently changed and submitted, the password manager picks up and updates to the new password.

cases.title: Form Submission with Unchanged Password
cases.description: Verify that submitting a login form with an unchanged password when a password update is expected does not incorrectly overwrite or corrupt stored credential records.

cases.title: Normal: Password Manager disabled prevents save prompts and prefilling
cases.description: Verify that when the password manager is disabled from the preferences panel, the browser no longer asks to save passwords and no longer prefill info on sites.

cases.title: Boundary: Disabling password manager while a save prompt is active
cases.description: Verify that disabling the password manager from preferences while a save password prompt is currently active immediately dismisses or invalidates the prompt and prevents saving.

cases.title: View saved credentials in preferences
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password are saved in the password manager, this information can be successfully viewed in the password manager through the preferences panel.

cases.title: View preferences list when empty
cases.description: Verify that attempting to view saved credentials in the password manager through preferences when no credentials are saved handles the empty list state gracefully.

cases.title: Remove single site credentials successfully
cases.description: Verify that removing a specific username and password for a given site results in the credentials no longer autofilling on that site nor being listed in the password manager.

cases.title: Remove the last remaining credential
cases.description: Verify that removing the absolute last remaining credential from the password manager correctly stops autofill on that site and leaves the manager empty.

cases.title: Remove all username and password information successfully
cases.description: Verify that when the user chooses to remove all stored username and password information, no credentials autofill on any sites and nothing is listed in the password manager preferences.

cases.title: Clear all credentials when password manager is already empty
cases.description: Verify the system behavior when the remove all credentials action is executed while the password manager storage is already empty, ensuring no errors occur and the list remains empty.

opinions.feedback: The test cases are comprehensive, well-structured, and appropriately cover both normal and alternative scenarios for all requirements. No blockers or missing scenario types were identified.
All requirements and their associated test cases are well-structured, clear, and cover both normal and boundary/error scenarios appropriately. No blockers found.

R-103: Normal (multiple credentials saved and presented later), Edge (zero credentials, single credential). R-104: Normal (password changed, manager picks up new password), Abnormal (form submitted with invalid/unchanged password). R-105: Normal (password manager disabled, no save prompt and no prefill), Boundary (disabling while a save prompt is currently active). R-106: Normal (saved credentials viewable in preferences), Abnormal (viewing when list is empty). R-107: Normal (remove single site credentials, no autofill and not listed), Boundary (removing last remaining credential). R-108: Normal (remove all credentials, no autofill and list empty), Edge (clearing when already empty).

coverage.feedback: Analysis of the accepted test cases against the requirements reveals the following coverage gaps based on the required scenario types (Normal, Edge, Boundary, Error): Requirement R-102 lacks an Error scenario (e.g., handling storage write failures when discarding/saving preferences). Requirement R-103 lacks an Edge or Boundary scenario for maximum limits of stored credentials per site. Requirement R-104 lacks an Error scenario for failed password updates due to malformed form data or network/storage lock errors. Requirement R-106 lacks an Error scenario for preference panel loading failures when credential storage is corrupted. Requirement R-107 lacks an Error scenario for failure to remove credentials due to locked storage. Requirement R-108 lacks an Error scenario for clearing storage when some records are locked or inaccessible. All requirements currently have Normal scenarios covered, but lack comprehensive Error and specific Boundary/Edge test types.
